'''Andreas Georgiou''' ({{langx|el|Ανδρέας Γεωργίου}}, born [[Patras]], 1960) is a Greek economist and former President of the [[Hellenic Statistical Authority]] (ELSTAT).<ref name="cv">[https://web.archive.org/web/20110804214843/http://www.statistics.gr/portal/page/portal/ESYE/BUCKET/General/Dr_Andreas_Georgiou_CVEN_0.pdf Bio of Georgiou from the Hellenic Statistical Authority site, archived 2011]</ref> In June 2021, he became the European Parliament’s representative at the European Statistical Governance Advisory Board, the body that provides an independent overview of the European Statistical System.<ref name="ekathimerini621">[https://www.ekathimerini.com/economy/1163071/former-elstat-chief-elected-member-of-european-statistical-governance-advisory-board/ Former ELSTAT chief elected member of European Statistical Governance Advisory Board ]</ref> Georgiou is a visiting lecturer and visiting scholar at [[Amherst College]].<ref name=AmherstCollege>{{cite web |last1=Cooper |first1=Rand R. |title=Sisyphus Retold by Kafka |url=https://www.amherst.edu/news/magazine/issues/2019-winter/sisyphus-retold-by-kafka |website=Amherst College |publisher=Amherst College |date=5 December 2018 |access-date=26 October 2025}}</ref> He is also an elected member of the Council of the [[International Statistical Institute]] and a member of the Committee on Professional Ethics of the [[American Statistical Association]].<ref name="ekathimerini621" />

== Biography ==
Georgiou completed his secondary education in [[Athens College]], and studied at [[Amherst College]], where he received his [[Bachelor of Arts]] (Summa Cum Laude) in Economics and in Political Science-Sociology. He went on to receive his Ph.D. in Economics from the [[University of Michigan]] with specialization in [[monetary theory]] and [[stabilisation policy]] as well as in International Trade and Finance.

From 1989 to July 2010 he was staff of the [[International Monetary Fund]] (IMF). He has been head of missions, responsible for the preparation, negotiation, and monitoring of economic programs with IMF member countries. From March 2004 to July 2010 he was deputy division chief in the IMF Statistics Department. During that period, among other things, he led the work of the statistical program for the methodological development and dissemination of new indicators of stability of financial systems (Financial Soundness Indicators). He has taught economics at the University of Michigan and as a visiting professor at the [[University of Economics in Bratislava]]. In addition, he has conducted seminars and courses in [[Methodology of econometrics|statistical methodologies]] for IMF staff as well as state officials of more than 120 countries.

On 2 August 2010, he was appointed President of the [[Hellenic Statistical Authority| Hellenic Statistical Authority (ELSTAT)]], which has the responsibility to produce, on a regular basis, official statistics for Greece. On 2 August 2015, he resigned from office with immediate effect.<ref>sueddeutsche.de 3. August 2015: [http://www.sueddeutsche.de/wirtschaft/griechenland-athener-boerse-oeffnet-wieder-und-stuerzt-ab-1.2592967 Athener Börse öffnet wieder - und stürzt ab]</ref><ref>[[Kathimerini]] 2. August 2015: [http://www.kathimerini.gr/825977/article/epikairothta/ellada/apoxwrei-apo-thn-elstat-meta-th-lh3h-ths-8hteias-toy-o-andreas-gewrgioy Αποχωρεί από την ΕΛΣΤΑΤ μετά τη λήξη της θητείας του ο Ανδρέας Γεωργίου]</ref>

Since 2018, Georgiou has been a visiting lecturer in Economics and Statistics at Amherst College, where he teaches  macroeconomics and statistical ethics.<ref name=AmherstCollege />

In June 2021, the European Parliament elected Mr Georgiou near-unanimously to one of the seats on the seven-member European Statistical Governance Advisory Board (ESGAB).<ref>
{{cite web |url=https://www.world-economics-journal.com/Papers/The-Case-of-Andreas-Georgiou-A-Travesty-of-Justice.aspx |title=The Case of Andreas Georgiou: A Travesty of Justice |last=Xafa |first=Miranda |date=September 2021 |website=World Economic Journal |access-date=November 1, 2021}}</ref>

== Accusation of Falsifying Greek Budget Statistics ==

In November 2010, after completing revised 2009 deficit and debt statistics of Greece, Georgiou transmitted them to Eurostat, without first receiving approval from the board of ELSTAT. In 2013, some members of the board accused him of artificially inflating the budget figures, 15.4% of GDP instead of 13.6% of GDP, and he was criminally charged with making a false statement.<ref>http://www.ekathimerini.com: [http://www.ekathimerini.com/229460/article/ekathimerini/news/top-court-upholds-suspended-prison-sentence-for-former-statistician ''Top court upholds suspended prison sentence for former statistician'']</ref><ref name=CalledToAccount>{{cite magazine|url=https://www.economist.com/news/finance-and-economics/21706276-disturbing-prosecution-greeces-chief-statistician-called-account |title=Called to account: The disturbing prosecution of Greece's chief statistician|magazine=The Economist|date=3 September 2016}}</ref>

In July 2016, the [[Court of Cassation (Greece)|Greek Supreme Court]] upheld charges against Georgiou for having harmed the "national interest",<ref>1331/2016 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160803061156/http://www.balkaneu.com/supreme-court-refers-andreas-georgiou-felony-charges/ Supreme Court refers Andreas Georgiou with felony charges] (2 August 2016))</ref> with a possible sentence of up to 10 years in prison.<ref>ft.com: [https://next.ft.com/content/f949ca70-58cd-11e6-9f70-badea1b336d4 Greece to press ahead with criminal trial for ex-statistics chief]</ref><ref>[[FAZ.net]] 3 August 2016: [https://www.faz.net/-gqe-8jzn8 Defizit zu hoch? Statistiker verklagen!] (translated: ''deficit too high ? Bring the statistician to trial!'')</ref>

In June 2018, the [[Supreme Civil and Criminal Court of Greece]] ('Areopagus') sentenced Georgiou to two years on probation for violation of duty for not first submitting the budget report to the ELSTAT board.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.iaos-isi.org/index.php/latestnews/221-80-former-chief-statisticians-condemn-prosecution-of-andreas-georgiou |title=''80 Former Chief Statisticians Condemn Prosecution of Andreas Georgiou'' |access-date=22 June 2018 |archive-date=23 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180623004930/http://www.iaos-isi.org/index.php/latestnews/221-80-former-chief-statisticians-condemn-prosecution-of-andreas-georgiou |url-status=dead }}</ref>

On 18 September 2018, during a Special Meeting on National Statistical Offices’ Professional Independence: Threats and Responses immediately prior to the XVI International Association for Official Statistics Conference in Paris, a special Commendation was awarded to Mr. Georgiou by six major international statistical organizations. This Commendation was given to "acknowledge Andreas Georgiou‘s upholding of the highest professional standards in his public service in the pursuit of integrity of statistical systems".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.isi-web.org/images/2018/Press%20release%20Commendation%20for%20Andreas%20Georgiou%20Aug%202018.pdf|title=Commendation of Andreas Georgiou|website=www.isi-web.org|access-date=2018-12-27|archive-date=17 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210417190332/https://www.isi-web.org/images/2018/Press%20release%20Commendation%20for%20Andreas%20Georgiou%20Aug%202018.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Georgiou's prosecution has been denounced as a violation of scientific freedom and human rights by the American Statistical Association's Committee on Scientific Freedom and Human Rights<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2021/05/01/asa-decries-georgiou-persecution/|title=ASA, International Community Continue to Decry Georgiou Persecution|publisher=American Statistical Association|magazine=AmStat News|date=1 May 2021}}</ref> and the editorial board of ''The Economist''.<ref name= CalledToAccount /> The ''Financial Times'' reported, "The case has sparked outrage from economists and statisticians worldwide who believe Mr. Georgiou has become a scapegoat for Greece's political class."<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.ft.com/content/31995e48-6073-11e6-b38c-7b39cbb1138a|newspaper=Financial Times|title=Greek statistician Andreas Georgiou hits back at criminal charges|date=14 August 2016}}</ref>

In August 2026, the Greek Supreme Court annulled the conviction and exonerated Georgiou.<ref>ISI Advisory Board on Ethics. [https://isi-web.org/statement/delayed-justice-andreas-georgiou-and-victory-statistical-ethics Delayed Justice for Andreas Georgiou and a Victory for Statistical Ethics]. 15 Sept 2026</ref><ref>James J. Cochran. [https://significancemagazine.com/andreas-georgiou-the-numbers-were-not-up-for-a-vote/ Andreas Georgiou: The numbers were not up for a vote]. ''Significance''. American Statistical Association. 15 Sept 2026</ref>
